set.body:
## Objective
Provide a reliable local activity and observation layer so a user can see what remote work agents are doing, survive client disconnects, and receive truthful attention guidance without making the journal a source of execution truth.

The activity journal is the shared presentation history. Remote execution ledgers, scheduler observations, validation receipts, and campaign state remain authoritative evidence. Suggested actions describe recommended next steps; they never grant permission to submit, retry, cancel, or validate.

## Scope
Deliver A0 through A4 from `docs/plans/activity-journal.md`: activity semantics and attention repair; transactional local journal and terminal reader; shared producers and passive recovery; persistent read-only observation; MCP activity surface and qualification.

This is WP8a. Resource interpretation, dashboard design, and packing advice belong to a later WP8b effort after this foundation is qualified.

## Delivery order
A0 semantics and attention rules -> A1 journal and terminal follow -> A2 producers and passive recovery -> A3 persistent observation -> A4 MCP surface and release qualification.

## Epic acceptance criteria
- All presentation events identify evidence provenance, exact subject/attempt identity, recorded/observed/occurred time, freshness, and causation where available.
- Journal insert, deduplication, and import checkpoint changes are atomic; independent readers use filter-bound opaque cursors and cannot consume one another's events.
- Every CLI, Python, and MCP operation reports equivalent request/outcome facts through shared operation boundaries.
- Recovery after an accepted response but before campaign-history update is passive and creates no submission-capable side effect.
- An observer continues through agent disconnect and daemon restart, makes read-only bounded remote calls, and exposes authentication failures, stale evidence, and observation gaps.
- `next_action` never reports all clear for missing output, unavailable evidence, stale validation, blocked dependencies, cancellation, or conflicting source evidence.
- Qualification covers crash windows, concurrent readers, lost replies, array and packed accounting, storage failure, budgets, and a candidate-specific live lifecycle.
set.title: [WP8a] Shared activity journal and persistent observation
